Gossip message filtering, signature checks, peer and ping tracking, and metrics for the gossvf tile.

# Purpose
This file defines the `gossvf` tile, which is a network-processing component for gossip traffic. It receives fragments from several input links, decodes Solana gossip messages, checks shred version rules, verifies signatures, filters inactive or invalid peers, updates peer and ping state, and forwards accepted messages to the output link. The tile also handles replayed stake updates, tracks entrypoints, and uses a round-robin input rule for network traffic. Its main role is to enforce local validation rules before gossip data is published to the next stage.

The file also defines the tile context, scratch memory layout, and startup logic for both privileged and unprivileged setup. It creates and joins pools and maps for peers, pings, and stakes, loads the node identity key, sets seccomp and file descriptor limits, and connects the tile to the `fd_stem` fragment-processing framework through callback functions such as [`during_housekeeping`](<#during_housekeeping>), [`before_frag`](<#before_frag>), [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>), and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>). It also records metrics for message and CRDS outcomes, and it uses a transaction cache to reject duplicate CRDS values.
